checks: Not unconditional: final publication + active matching instance RunAttempt in channel
Reply itself has no thread/attachment/canonical mention/broadcast
Exactly one inbox source within this activation range; not arbitrary catchup
Source message is top-level directed once to this recipient; excludes broadcast/attachments/comment
No return of a previous replyReturn
Requester provenance from worker_run_message_writes matches current session generation
Requester differs, enabled and still member of same channel
Exact activation/run presented window contains source seq and sent_at is nonnull
One return per request; explicit earlier reply consumes allowance
Uses existing inbox/lane chain guard; busy requester queues; no separate waiting loop
Role ID config, immutable Revision, Instance principal, continuous native Session distinct
Delete soft marks Role only; running instances/session/snapshots remain
New same-name Role gets distinct ID, cannot merge old instances
Active names normalization uniqueness; old retained instance names not reused
Restoring occupied Tom rejects; choose available name or free it
Restore preserves old Role ID, creates new Revision; old instance Revision unchanged
Human management authority and control-room causal freshness required
Expected Revision prevents stale edits/deletes/restores
Exact successful idempotent replay returns prior result, not new mutation
Restart default keeps actual config; adopt explicit latest revision with membership/live-run/cleanup/leased/reserved fences; can change CLI only at explicit restart

scoring.correctness: 10 checks x 0/2.5/5; contradiction gets 0, partially correct 2.5, correct 5
scoring.evidence: 25: concrete source/test citations actually support statements; no requirement to cite every line
scoring.boundary: 15: causal boundaries connected to scenario, not merely listed
scoring.uncertainty: 10: separates read-code/test-existence from actual execution, no invented failures or claims tests were run
scoring.critical_errors: Record separately: wrong identity merge, deletion kills instances, unconditional automatic return, claiming unrun tests passed
scoring.limitations: Manual rubric-based judgement is not objective correctness proof; no significance claim with n=3. Final score paired with critical-error evidence.
